findings.explanation: The figure 16508 is labelled as a 2012 census value in Wikipedia EN, but INE withdrew the 2012 census results, rendering it a discredited source.
The figure 16,418 does not match any official INE census (2002, 2017, 2024), projection, urban, or rural figure for Curacautín, and no source provided explains it.
The claimed 2017 census figure 25,413 differs from INE's official 2017 census count of 17,413; the discrepancy is most likely a typographical error given the digit mismatch.

findings.explanation: 16,508 is attributed to the 2012 census, whose results INE withdrew; it is not an official figure. The current official figure is the Census 2024 count, 18,536.
The infobox gives 16,508 ('2012 Census'), while the Historical populations table already gives the 2024 census figure, 18,536.
Wikidata's newest population statement is 16,508 (point in time 2020-01-01); Census 2024 counted 18,536, and Wikidata has no statement for it.

Wikidata's population statements have no point in time on 16,418; no determination method on 16,508, 16,418; no reference on 16,508, 16,418; no statement is ranked preferred, so all of them count as current.
